finish_summary: Submitted a runnable SKY130 transistor-level two-stage differential candidate using an NMOS differential input pair, PMOS active loads, NMOS common-source output devices, a reference-derived current bias, and resistive output-average common-mode feedback. The approved-device checker passed. Public TT/1.8 V/27 C diagnostics observed output common-mode error 38.5 mV, power 0.648 mW, and closed-loop differential gain 13.05 dB. The settling diagnostic observed high static output 0.402 V for a 0.9 V command, rise error at 10 ns of 64.9%, and fall error at 10 ns of 11.5%; it failed the nominal accuracy/settling target. The loop-gain diagnostic did not find a unity crossing. No PVT, range, noise, CMFB-recovery, or mismatch signoff was obtained. The circuit therefore is not claimed to meet the full specification.
